activity.notes: Philip IV succeeded Philip III in 1621 and remained king of the Spanish Monarchy until his death in 1665. His reign encompassed the later Thirty Years' War, recognition of Dutch independence, the loss of Portugal, and the Peace of the Pyrenees. ATLAS uses the existing composite Spanish Monarchy polity rather than treating each crown and territory as a separate duplicate reign.

sources.title: Philip IV, King of Spain — Treccani
sources.citation_text: Treccani states that Philip IV succeeded his father in 1621 and died in 1665.
